title: Settings
lead: Your name, your handle, your picture, and the language this browser shows.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. The address belongs to your sign-in method and is changed there.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown above your circuits. Leave it empty to be known by your handle alone.
profile.usernameHint: Your public address. Changing it moves your profile page, and every link anyone has to it.
profile.usernameShape: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, from 3 to 32 characters.
profile.avatarProvider: Use the picture from the account I signed in with
profile.avatarHint: There is no upload yet. The drawn picture is derived from your account, so it is always available and it is never anybody else’s file.

language.heading: Language
language.note: The language is remembered in this browser rather than on your account, so it stays the one you picked here whether you are signed in or not.

danger.heading: Delete your account
danger.body: This removes your circuits, every version of them, your collections and your stars. It cannot be undone.
danger.identityNote: Your sign-in method itself is kept by the provider you signed in with, so signing in again gives you a new, empty account rather than this one back.
